posts.title: What Medicare Advantage Plans Do
posts.description: I thought i understood the relationship between Medicare Advantsge plans and Medicare. I was talking someone from church who runs a benefits plan. Medicare Advantage plans get paid a per head amount each year by Medicare. In exchange, they bill and pay providers.
